## Install

```sh
opencode plugin @mirrowel/opencode-config-studio@dev --global
```

## What's Changed

### Features
- feat(tools): generated TUI map - tools/generate-tui-map.mjs walks the real menus via the probe host (5 scenarios incl. AV-sidecar agent shape; raw-value edge keys; raw path replay) and emits docs/TUI_MAP.md (Part 0 edit-index, per-menu Path/gists/leaf markers, state+list aggregates, pin tags); test:tui-map drift check wired into ci:package ([`88405b1`](https://github.com/Mirrowel/opencode-config-studio/commit/88405b163a549efb58499a08613a5c38b40718af)) by @Mirrowel
- feat(modes): unified task-list & calling in the studio - AV module replaces the plain Hidden/Disabled rows with the wizard's 5-mode picker (agentDetailReplacedFields capability), plain Disabled field added for the no-AV case, submenu disable rows collapsed into the picker link, pinId generalized for all pinnable root-key screens, dead quick-access switch cases + DEFAULT_QUICK_ACCESS removed, live keybind count, Models (catalog) vs Model entries (config) title split, agent.hidden field docs ([`b0620f5`](https://github.com/Mirrowel/opencode-config-studio/commit/b0620f527255637e573fd1f802dea02c0defc44c)) by @Mirrowel

### Maintenance
- chore(deps): av ^0.12.0-dev.9 (unified task-list & calling, drift self-heal, config-flag writes) ([`f21f7a3`](https://github.com/Mirrowel/opencode-config-studio/commit/f21f7a317bbee9727f0c60833ae443ac78267df1)) by @Mirrowel
